name: Throneglass Shard
text:
Throneglass is an incredibly rare resource created during the violence of Earthfall 10,000 years ago, when the impact of falling stars enhanced certain shattered panes of green glass built into the architecture of important buildings in Azlant—particularly the Imperial Palace. As a material, throneglass is as strong as steel, but the ancient methods of crafting it into weapons have long been lost. Low-grade throneglass offers no additional benefit to a weapon crafted from it other than the cosmetic and intrinsic value of the precious material, but standard-grade and high-grade throneglass can retain psychic power and then release it through a strike.

When a creature wielding a standard-grade or high-grade throneglass weapon succeeds at a saving throw against a mental effect, the weapon stores some of that energy and holds it for a future attack. A standard-grade weapon can hold this energy for 1 round before it dissipates harmlessly, while a high-grade one can hold the energy for 1 minute. The next time you Strike a creature with a throneglass weapon with stored energy, the creature struck must attempt a Will save (DC 24 for standard-grade throneglass, or DC 35 for high-grade throneglass) to avoid becoming Stupefied 1 for 1 round (or Stupefied 2 on a critical failure).
